names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 24 октября ст. ст., «Преподобный Феофил Печерский, затворник», with the rank word and the state of life left off. The line itself declines it, as «Прпп. ... и Феофила (XII-XIII), затворников Печерских».

feast.note: His life page heads «Дни памяти: 28 сентября (Печер.(Б)) , 24 октября», the September day being the synaxis of the venerable of the Near caves; the life the three of them share adds the second Sunday of Great Lent, which is reckoned from Pascha and which this schema cannot hold. One row per church is the schema, so the September day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 октября ст. ст. — «Прпп. Арефы (XII), Сисоя (XIII) и Феофила (XII-XIII), затворников Печерских.»

attestations.note: The day page prints no hymn for him, and his own page is three sentences long. «В чудесех изящный», the phrase the shared life quotes out of the common service, is an epithet of the service and not a rank word, so it is said in the life and kept out of `types`. THE JULIAN 29 ДЕКАБРЯ IS A DIFFERENT THEOPHILUS, AND NO SECOND ROW IS MADE. Read 13 October 2026. The line is «Прпп. Марка гробокопателя, Феофила и Иоанна Печерских (XI-XII).» and the two lives behind it are life3195, the Paterikon account of the three, and life6622, the short notice of the pair. What settles it is not the lives — neither of them names a day or an epithet this folder carries — but **the calendar's own name index, which keeps these men apart by design and in adjacent entries, and lists for each the days he is kept on.** The name link behind that Феофил is name page **2269, «Преподобный Феофил Плачливый»**, Theophilus the Weeper, and it heads «Дни памяти: 28 сентября (Печер.(Б)) , 29 декабря» — **24 октября, this folder's day, is not among them.** This folder's man stands behind name page **2270, «Преподобный Феофил Печерский, затворник»**, whose days are 28 сентября and 24 октября. Two consecutive entries in one index, neither listing the other's day. The centuries part as well: the 29 декабря line closes «(XI-XII)» and life6622 has the pair struggle «в конце XI - начале XII вв.», where this folder holds «(XII-XIII)» off its own line and off both of its own pages. And the dossiers are nothing alike. The Weeper is one of two brother-monks who loved each other so much that they begged Mark the Gravedigger to prepare them a single grave; who came back from an errand to find his younger brother dead and laid in the elder's place, and was answered by Mark telling the dead man to move over, which he did; who then gave away everything he had but his mantle, waited for his own death every day, wept until he lost his sight, and was told by Mark that he would see again three days before the end. This folder's Theophilus is a recluse with no story at all — three sentences and a phrase out of the common service. BOTH PAIRS LIE IN THE SAME CAVES AND SHARE THE SAME SYNAXIS, WHICH IS WHY THEY READ ALIKE AND IS NEITHER A RELATION NOR AN IDENTITY: every one of these men is kept in the 28 сентября commemoration of the venerable of the Near (Antoniev) caves, and sharing a day is not a relation, the same way a dedication is not. NO FOLDER WAS MADE for Theophilus the Weeper, for his brother John, or for Mark the Gravedigger: a new folder is a different operation from this one, and the 29 декабря line is left for whoever reads that day. NOT CHECKED: no Paterikon edition outside days.pravoslavie.ru was consulted, and the 28 сентября synaxis page was not opened to see whether it numbers the two Theophiluses and the two Johns separately — the name index already does.

floruit.note: The day's line gives him «(XII-XIII)», his own page says «Подвизался в Киево-Печерском монастыре в ХII-ХIII веках», and the life the three of them share heads all three the same way; the two readings agree here, where they disagree for the second of the three. No year of birth or death is given anywhere, so this is a floruit and not a death. Read 4 October 2026.
